headline: DCM Shriram Industries announces change in RTA corporate office address
summary: DCM Shriram Industries has notified exchanges about a change in the corporate office address of its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA). The relocation will be effective from December 1, 2026. This is a routine administrative update regarding shareholder services and documentation. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company need to note the new RTA address for future physical correspondence.
why_it_matters: Update physical shareholder documentation for future correspondence.
